scene.hook: How a CI/CD pipeline ships a commit

steps.label: Push
steps.detail: A developer pushes a commit and the CI server picks it up

steps.label: Build
steps.detail: The pipeline installs dependencies and compiles the code

steps.label: Test
steps.detail: Automated tests run, and any failure stops the pipeline

steps.label: Package
steps.detail: The build is packaged as an artifact or container image

steps.label: Deploy
steps.detail: The artifact rolls out to staging, then to production

scene.takeaway: Every commit takes the same tested path to production

scene.hook: What happens when you call an LLM API

steps.label: Request
steps.detail: Your code sends a prompt and settings as a JSON request body

steps.label: Authenticate
steps.detail: The service checks your key and the rate limit on your account

steps.label: Tokenize
steps.detail: The prompt text is split into tokens the model can read as input

steps.label: Generate
steps.detail: The model predicts one token at a time until it reaches a stop

steps.label: Stream
steps.detail: Tokens can stream back to your app while generation continues

steps.label: Bill
steps.detail: Input and output tokens are counted to measure what you used

scene.takeaway: An API call is a request, a token loop and a bill for every token used

scene.hook: The story of the Hubble Space Telescope

milestones.event: Lyman Spitzer proposes a telescope in space
Space Shuttle Discovery launches Hubble into orbit
Astronauts fix its flawed mirror in orbit
The fifth and final servicing mission upgrades it
The James Webb Space Telescope launches as a partner

scene.takeaway: Repairable by design, Hubble kept working for decades
